rows.Origin:
Discovered by Arnaud Delbard (France, before 2003).
Introduced in France by Delbard/Georges Delbard SA in 2003 as 'Pink Intuition'.
rows.Bloom: Pink, deep pink stripes. Mild fragrance. 31 to 39 petals. Average diameter 4.25". Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Medium green foliage. 3 to 7 leaflets.

Height: up to 5' (up to 150cm). Width: up to 28" (up to 70cm).
rows.Patents:
France - Patent No: 18858 on 12 Jul 2004
United States - Patent No: PP 16,906 on 1 Aug 2006 VIEW USPTO PATENT
Application No: 11/022,762 on 28 Dec 2004
Inventors: Delbard; Arnaud (Malicorne, FR)

Assignee: Societe Anonyme des Pepinieres et Roseraies Georges Delbard (Commentry, FR)

The new Rosa hybrida Hybrid Tea rose plant was discovered in a greenhouse at Malicorne, France, during 2003, and is a spontaneous mutation of unknown causation of the `Delstriro` variety (U.S. Plant Pat. No. 13,086).
